children: Mining and capital allocation executive with LatAm advisory experience, and senior roles at BHP and Vale joins the Board

”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Daniel Kuhl to the Board of directors as an independent, non-executive director effective 7 October, 2026. Mr. Kuhl brings 25 years of international mining and resources experience in capital allocation, strategic planning and M&A, together with familiarity with Resouro from a prior engagement as advisor on the Novo Mundo gold project.

Mr. Kuhl most recently served as Senior Advisor and Country Lead for Oliver Wyman in Santiago, Chile, advising mining and industrial executives across Latin America on strategy, AI transformation and productivity improvement, and previously led Amazon Web Services (AWS)’s global account relationships with its largest mining and metals clients through 2023. This recent work follows more than a decade of senior roles at BHP and Vale, where he chaired BHP Coal’s Investments and Contracts Committee, approving about US$7 billion in capital projects and contract commitments, and supported more than US$5 billion in growth and M&A opportunities at Vale. He holds an MBA from the MIT Sloan School of Management, is Brazilian-born and based in Latin America.
“Daniel’s background in capital allocation and project evaluation at BHP and Vale, combined
him a strong addition to the Board as we advance our Brazilian projects,”
said Simon Stilwell, Resouro’s Non-Executive Chairman.
This announcement has been authorized for release by the Board of Directors of Resouro Strategic Metals Inc.

Resouro is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company focused on the discovery and development of economic mineral projects in Brazil. Its flagship Tiros Titanium and Rare Earth Elements Project is comprised of 28 mineral concessions totalling 497 km² in the state of Minas Gerais, one of Brazil’s most infrastructurally developed states. The Tiros Project is supported by a JORC-compliant Mineral Resource Estimate and a Preliminary Economic Assessment for a starter operation. Resouro is also developing the Novo Mundo gold project, located in Mato Grosso state.
